headline: Small E windswell, glassy early then onshore — log it in the morning or skip it.
today: Barely knee-to-thigh at short period, but the E angle is workable and the wind is light SSW through morning so it'll be clean. Get the dawn to mid-morning window before the SSE onshore fills in around midday and kills it. Bring the log, nothing else will do much.

daysToWatch.note: SSE prime angle but only building small and onshore 17-20mph all day. Blown out — skip it.
The one to rearrange for. 3-3.6ft SE at good angle with WNW cross-off winds morning into midday. Short period but plenty of size — shortboard or fish, go early.
Leftover 2ft-ish with cross-off NW all morning. Fun cleanup day on the groveler.
